measurementSource: GitHub REST repository metadata plus current README and LICENSE files

projects.name: AI Engineering Hub
projects.quickStart: Choose a documented project/tutorial; there is no single runtime or dependency set for the whole collection.
projects.requirements: Requirements vary by selected project; some examples may require model-provider credentials or local model hardware.
projects.costs: Repository itself is free under MIT; compute/API costs depend on the chosen example.

projects.name: Google Gen AI SDK
projects.quickStart: Install google-genai, configure a Gemini Developer API key or Google Cloud credentials, then instantiate the documented client.
projects.requirements: Supported Python runtime plus provider authentication; API v3 defaults the Gemini Developer API to v1.
projects.costs: SDK is open source; model/API use may incur provider charges. It is not a local model runtime.

projects.name: Lasm
projects.quickStart: Use npm create @lasm@latest my-app -- --template hono, then npm install and npm run dev.
projects.requirements: Lean 4 toolchain and Node.js/npm for the documented starter; runtime targets include Node, Bun, Deno, browser and several cloud platforms.
projects.costs: Local development is free; deploying to managed cloud targets depends on the chosen host and its pricing.

projects.name: MarkItDown
projects.quickStart: Install the package and use the documented conversion entry point for a local file or stream.
projects.requirements: Python runtime; optional extras depend on the document types and conversion features needed.
projects.costs: Core conversion is local and does not require a paid model API; optional external services, if configured, have separate costs.
projects.securityNote: The README warns that conversion runs with the current process privileges; use narrow conversion functions and sanitize untrusted inputs.

projects.name: Minecraft Agent Harness
projects.quickStart: Follow the README quickstart and select a documented example after configuring the local game and model provider.
projects.requirements: Node.js 22.19+ and Minecraft Java 1.21.6; provider credentials may be required.
projects.costs: Local game/server costs depend on hardware; hosted model calls may incur API charges.

projects.name: OpenShell
projects.quickStart: Use the official OpenShell documentation and repository quickstart; verify runtime/backend requirements before deploying.
projects.requirements: CLI and a supported sandbox/runtime environment as specified by the current official docs; requirements depend on the selected backend.
projects.costs: Open-source code is free under Apache-2.0; infrastructure and any hosted model provider are separate costs.

projects.name: Pydantic AI
projects.quickStart: Install pydantic-ai, configure one supported model provider, then create an Agent using the documented API.
projects.requirements: Python runtime and credentials or endpoint configuration for the selected model provider.
projects.costs: Framework is local/open source; inference costs depend on hosted provider or local hardware.

projects.name: uv
projects.quickStart: Install uv, initialize a project, add dependencies, and run the project using the README/documentation workflow.
projects.requirements: Supported OS/architecture for the uv binary; no model provider is required.
projects.costs: Local package/project management; no cloud or model API cost is inherent.
